overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for Steiner: learning outcomes (all three sub-groups), content, coursework requirements (Arbeidskrav) and assessment are cut correctly in all 13 courses, including the arbeidskrav-vs-assessment split. Only minor noise (page numbers, retained exam-logistics lines) and one course whose page text does not match its course id were found; all pre-pass flags are false alarms.

findings.description: The PDF page number (11, 15) at the end of the plan is left as the last line of assessment. Assessment also keeps some exam-logistics lines (aids, 'Ny/utsatt eksamen' re-sit text, Sensorordning) in some courses while dropping them in others, so cleanup is inconsistent.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Text-fallback sectionizer does not strip bare page-number lines and only partly strips exam-logistics sub-headings (Hjelpemidler, Sensorordning, Ny/utsatt eksamen) in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (R/extract_sections.R) drop lines matching ^\d{1,3}$ at the end of a section, and drop the Hjelpemidler/Sensorordning/Ny-utsatt eksamen sub-blocks consistently from assessment.

findings.description: Course steiner_M-PEL2.2 (Pedagogikk og elevkunnskap 2, emne 2) carries a plan text that is headed Pedagogikk og elevkunnskap 1, emne 5 (PEL1.5, FoU-oppgave). The sections are extracted correctly from that text, but they probably belong to a different course than the id/title says (wrong source page or a wrong URL mapping).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: URL builder/source_course_id for Steiner maps M-PEL2.2 to the PEL1.5 page, or the institution reuses one page for several codes.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the URL built for M-PEL2.2 in R/add_course_url.R and compare the emnekode in the page text with course_code; flag mismatches in the harvest checks.
